text:
maria.g: Heads up — planning an orchestrated catalog cutover for model 'halley-7b-quantv2' tomorrow 03/20 23:00 UTC. Change window 60m. Goal: enable quantv2 as primary, ensure fallback ordering and pins are correct, and have rollback thresholds defined. Please ACK and call out any blockers.

sam.k: Ack. I'll own the canary (first 10m) and the ramp to 30%.

deploy-bot: /deploy request created by @maria.g — target=halley-7b-quantv2 stage=canary canary_duration=10m change_window=60m

dana: Quick notes: lower the latency alert thresholds for the canary (p95) — recommend alarm at +50% baseline for 5m. Rollback trigger: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m or p95 > 1200ms.

maria.g: Adding to checklist. Rollback plan: immediate pin to 'halley-7b-fp16' if triggers hit. Also keep an eye on tokenization diffs (rare) flagged in prior rolls.

ryan: Also need an explicit catalog fallback order update so runtime doesn't accidentally prefer legacy variants. Proposed snippet to apply during cutover: 

```
fallback_order: ["halley-7b-quantv2", "halley-7b-fp16", "halley-7b-legacy", "default-small"]
pin_overrides:
  customer:enterprise: "halley-7b-fp16"
quant_profile: "quantv2-medium-latency"
```

sam.k: I'll run smoke + perf baseline replay against the canary config. ETA ~1h. Will post results at 10m mark.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. If we hit rollback thresholds, I'll run `/rollback-catalog halley-7b-quantv2 --to halley-7b-fp16` and notify infra and support.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 1768010200 UTC. Region: us-west2-a. Canary traffic: 5%. Instances spun up: 12 quantv2 pods.

maria.g: Observability dash: https://console.redwood/telemetry/canary/halley-7b-quantv2 — watch tokens/sec, p95 latency, and error rate. Link to kernel perf: https://console.redwood/kernels/halley-quantv2

sam.k: 10m check-in: canary looks healthy. Error rate 0.3%, p95 +80ms vs baseline. No obvious regressions in sample prompts. Proceeding to ramp to 30% over next 10m. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Proceed with ramp. Please update release notes during the ramp: mention quantv2 added, quant profile used, kernels validated, and canary metrics.

dana: Added a temporary fallback TTL override to 30s to allow faster eviction of hot prefixes if we need to force-fallback quickly. Documented in ops checklist.

deploy-bot: Cutover completed at 1768010500 UTC. Traffic now 100% -> halley-7b-quantv2. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

ryan: Post-cutover notes: FP16 left as immediate fallback. Verified quant kernels on 4 hardware configs. QA found a minor tokenization difference on very long code blocks — filing follow-up INC-203 and a small eval to triage.

maria.g: Thanks all — good run. Closing this cutover thread. If any customer-facing issues appear, route to #support and tag me.

deploy-bot: Deployment summary: model=halley-7b-quantv2 status=SUCCESS canary=10m change_window=60m rollouts: us-west2-a/100% time=1768010500
